name: Daniel Singh
stance: Opposed the federal moratorium partly on the ground that it would have put control of artificial general intelligence in Washington's hands.

statements.text: Had the 10-year moratorium passed, we could have seen one of the greatest technological leaps in human history—the invention of Artificial General Intelligence—placed under the control of Congress in Washington, D.C.

review.note: research pass, September 2026; not yet reviewed
